sn2.23:1.1: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho serī devaputto bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
sn2.23:8.1: bhūtapubbāhaṃ bhante serī nāma rājā ahosiṃ dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī.
sn2.23:8.2: tassa mayhaṃ bhante catūsu dvāresu dānaṃ dīyittha samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇaddhikavaṇibbakayācakānaṃ.
sn2.23:8.3: atha kho maṃ bhante itthāgāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
sn2.23:8.4: devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati
sn2.23:8.5: sādhu mayampi devaṃ nissāya dānāni dadeyyāma puññāni kareyyāmāti.
sn2.23:8.7: ahaṃ khosmi dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī
sn2.23:8.9: so khvāhaṃ bhante paṭhamadvāraṃ itthāgārassa adāsiṃ
sn2.23:8.10: tattha itthāgārassa dānaṃ dīyittha mama dānaṃ paṭikkami.
sn2.23:9.1: atha kho maṃ bhante khattiyā anuyuttā upasaṅkamitvā maṃ etadavocuṃ
sn2.23:9.2: devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati itthāgārassa dānaṃ dīyati amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati
sn2.23:9.3: sādhu mayampi devaṃ nissāya dānāni dadeyyāma puññāni kareyyāmāti.
sn2.23:9.5: ahaṃ khosmi dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī
sn2.23:9.7: so khvāhaṃ bhante dutiyadvāraṃ khattiyānaṃ anuyuttānaṃ adāsiṃ
sn2.23:9.8: tattha khattiyānaṃ anuyuttānaṃ dānaṃ dīyittha mama dānaṃ paṭikkami.
sn2.23:10.1: atha kho maṃ bhante balakāyo upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
sn2.23:10.2: devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati itthāgārassa dānaṃ dīyati khattiyānaṃ anuyuttānaṃ dānaṃ dīyati amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati
sn2.23:10.3: sādhu mayampi devaṃ nissāya dānāni dadeyyāma puññāni kareyyāmāti.
sn2.23:10.5: ahaṃ khosmi dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī
sn2.23:10.7: so khvāhaṃ bhante tatiyadvāraṃ balakāyassa adāsiṃ
sn2.23:10.8: tattha balakāyassa dānaṃ dīyittha mama dānaṃ paṭikkami.
sn2.23:11.1: atha kho maṃ bhante brāhmaṇagahapatikā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
sn2.23:11.2: devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati itthāgārassa dānaṃ dīyati khattiyānaṃ anuyuttānaṃ dānaṃ dīyati balakāyassa dānaṃ dīyati amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati
sn2.23:11.3: sādhu mayampi devaṃ nissāya dānāni dadeyyāma puññāni kareyyāmāti.
sn2.23:11.5: ahaṃ khosmi dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī
sn2.23:11.7: so khvāhaṃ bhante catutthadvāraṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ adāsiṃ
sn2.23:11.8: tattha brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ dānaṃ dīyittha mama dānaṃ paṭikkami.
sn2.23:12.1: atha kho maṃ bhante purisā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
sn2.23:12.2: na khodāni devassa koci dānaṃ dīyatīti.
sn2.23:12.3: evaṃ vuttāhaṃ bhante te purise etadavocaṃ
sn2.23:12.4: tenahi bhaṇe yo bāhiresu janapadesu āyo sañjāyati tato upaḍḍhaṃ antepuraṃ pavesetha upaḍḍhaṃ tattheva dānaṃ detha samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇaddhikavaṇibbakayācakānanti.
sn2.23:12.5: so khvāhaṃ bhante evaṃ dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ puññānaṃ evaṃ dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ kusalānaṃ pariyantaṃ nādhigacchāmi
sn2.23:12.6: ettakaṃ puññanti vā ettako puññavipākoti vā ettakaṃ samagge ṭhātabbanti vāti.
